Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
Panjab University
Science Block-II, Sector-25, Chandigarh-160014
ADVT. NO. JRF- 06/02/2026
ADVERTISEMENT FOR JRF UNDER ANRF SPONSORED PROJECT
Applications are invited for the appointment of JRFs under ANRF sponsored project entitled "Dynamic Research
Ecosystem for Advanced Materials (DREAMS)" under PAIR scheme on a purely temporary (co-terminus with
the project) basis for the candidates fulfilling the following eligibility criteria:

1. The last date for submitting the application is 15 February 2026.
2. The norms & guidelines for service conditions, age limit, etc. for scientific/technical manpower will be as per
ANRF notification w. r. t. ANRF/OM/N-01/2024 or any later official notification.
3. There are total of 06 Nos. sanctioned JRF posts (purely temporary) under the ANRF sponsored project. However, the
exact no of available posts will depend on the vacancy at the time interview.
Salary & Benefits: Rs. 37,000/- + HRA (as per applicable rules) subjected to fulfillment of T&C of funding agency
and/or rules and regulations of Panjab University.
Note: The short listed candidates duly recommended by Screening/Selection Committee will be called for an
interview through email. The date and time of the interview will be intimated to the candidates through e-
mail/telephonically. Outstation candidates may be allowed to appear in the interview through video conferencing
on prior request with justification. No Transport Allowance (TA) will be paid for attending the interview.
How to apply:
Interested candidates may email their applications in a single pdf file with detailed biodata (including contact number
and email address) and copies of mark sheets and relevant certificates to cnsnt@pu.ac.in by 15 February 2026
(advanced copy only). Hard copies of the application must be submitted to the office by post/hand. Application form
can be found at department website: https://nsnt.puchd.ac.in (under careers/placement/training).
Note: The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email only along with the interview date.
Sd/
Dr. Jadab Sharma
Principal Investigator of PAIR project &
Chairperson
Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
Panjab University, Chandigarh
GENERAL CONDITIONS
1. These positions are open only to Indian Nationals/Overseas citizens of India.
2. The posts are purely temporary (co-terminus with the project) and appointment will be in the Centre for
Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Panjab University, Chandigarh. The successful candidate will join a
large team that includes collaborators from the Indian Institute of Technology, IIT-Ropar. Continuation
in the post will be subjected to satisfactory performance every year.
3. The engagement is initially for a temporary duration of one year and is extendable subject to successful
evaluation of progress report and performance (upgradation to SRF from third year based on performance).
4. Age limit will be reckoned as on last date of receipt of application as per guidelines of funding
agency. Age relaxation is as applicable as per PU/government guidelines.
5. The period of experience in a discipline/area of work, where prescribed, shall be counted with effect from
the date of acquiring the prescribed minimum educational qualifications for the post.
6. As the Screening/Shortlisting of applications will be done on the basis of information furnished through
the e-mail or offline application form by the applicants, it is necessary that only accurate, full and correct
information is furnished by the applicants. Furnishing of wrong/false information will be a
disqualification and Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Panjab University will NOT be
responsible for any of the consequences of furnishing such wrong/false information.
7. The decision of Screening/Selection Committee in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or
rejection of applications, mode of selection, conduct of Skill Test will be final and binding on the
candidates and no enquiry or correspondence will be entertained in this connection from any individual
or agency on behalf of the candidate. Candidates are binding on Panjab University guidelines for any
points not traversed in General conditions.
8. Canvassing in any form and/or bringing in any influence political or otherwise will be treated as a
disqualification for the post.
9. After the appointment, the candidate is advised to work for the project for minimum one-year duration
and appointment will be purely temporary and subject to fulfilment of terms and conditions.
10. No additional grants/salary will be paid apart from the fellowship amount.
11. In case the candidate wishes to leave the job, prior information of minimum o f 0 2 months is
needed.
12. On account of official visit to other places/Laboratories/Institutes, a candidate will be entitled for
reimbursement under the project as per rules of Panjab University.
13. Eligible candidates may download the application form from Centre for Nanoscience and
Nanotechnology website: https://nsnt.puchd.ac.in (under careers/placement/training). The application form is
also given at the end of the full advertisement). Application form duly filled in together along with recent
passport size photograph, copies of matriculation, 12th, Degree and above, Experience and certificate
with reference to nature of work carried out etc., should be sent in a sealed cover superscribing:
“Application for the post of JUNIOR RESEARCH FELLOW”
Advt. No. JRF-06/02/2026
Addressed to:
Principal Investigator
Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
Panjab University
Science Block-II, Sector-25, Chandigarh-160014
Important: Those candidates who had applied against Advt. No. JRF-06/01/2025 and were unsuccessful, need not apply again and they
will not be considered for the current/future advertisement under the same project.
